city_center.name: Downtown Des Moines / Court Avenue + riverfront
city_center.landmark: The gold-domed Iowa State Capitol on the east side above the Des Moines River; the Court Avenue brick district and the Downtown Farmers' Market
city_center.notes: Des Moines sits at the confluence of the Des Moines and Raccoon rivers in the heart of Iowa's corn-and-soybean country; the gold-domed capitol is the civic landmark and the Downtown Farmers' Market is a major summer gathering. Hy-Vee is headquartered in Iowa and dominates the Des Moines and statewide market -- ~65% of Iowa grocery visits in one monthly report. sources: Hy-Vee Iowa 65% visit share (supermarketnews.com Kroger-Hy-Vee January visits); Hy-Vee Iowa roots (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hy-Vee).
